# Controls pack

> Resource packaged with textbook edition 0.48 (14 October 2026): 50 draft chapters across Units 1–4; all four editorial coverage maps are available. Independent review and learner evidence remain pending. Original authoring dates below are provenance, not new sign-off; teacher keys are separate but not access-protected.

Run `python unit4-controls-model.py` offline with the standard library. No network, operating-system or account permissions are changed. This first-match model covers new connection initiation; it is not a deployed firewall, connection-state handler, DNS/DHCP service, IPv6 configuration, authentication service or ownership checker. Exact role grants are simplified assumptions. Teacher files are separate, not access-protected. Two explicit Week 7 lessons accompany two separate project workshops. Original draft: 14 October 2026; source review, classroom evidence and independent review remain pending.
